sam: Heads-up: partner manifest shows two different SKU labels mapping to the same rack family for APAC Dedicated (skus `g4e-64` and `g4e-64-fw1`). This created duplicate reservations.
elaine: Oof. Are any customer commits impacted?
vik: Quick check: 36 total units in manifest, our system split into 34 canonical + 2 `-fw1`. Two pilot customers reference the `-fw1` reservations, no active provisioning.
partner-bot: [info] Manifest VP-3444 uploaded 2026-05-02T03:12:00Z (file: vp3444.csv).

elaine: Also notify partner and SI leads to pause claiming `-fw1` SKUs. I'll draft a short partner note.
vik: I'll run the dry-run: `tools/sku_map --file vp3444.csv --map fw1->canonical --dry-run --include-commits` ETA 8m.
ops-bot: [alert] Claims paused for pattern `g4e-64*` by elaine at 2026-05-02T03:20:10Z.

vik: Proceed. I'll run the canonicalize job with `notify=true` and audit flag.
ops-bot: [info] Canonicalize job started by vik at 2026-05-02T03:31:05Z.
vik: Job complete. Reservations merged, canonical active=36, pilots preserved. No provisioning errors in checks.
elaine: Partner note posted and SI leads looped. Link: https://partners.redwood.ai/announcements/VP-3444
sam: Follow-ups: add ingest normalizer to strip known firmware suffixes (INF-8101), nightly alias check, and finance audit of recon CSV. Closing unless issues. :wave:
